widgetTool.name: acn-investment-card
widgetTool.description: Emit an interactive GIC and Registered Account investment rate projector card with 5-year compounding growth graph. Requires financial advice disclaimer and CDIC notice. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Here are our current GIC and registered investment rates.'

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'acn-investment-card'

principal.description: Default principal amount in CAD to project returns (e.g., 25000).
